(2) COBRO AUTOMÁTICO / POST /api/billing/run-monthly → returns {ok, period, invoiced, charged, skipped, failed}; idempotent per period (second run invoiced=0, skipped increased); requires admin (401/403 without token). (3) DESCUENTOS: created invoice with items [Cuota 20€, Descuento -5€], total=15.00 € correct in inv-total and persisted; invoice with total<=0 rejected with HTTP 400 'El total de la factura debe ser mayor que 0 €' (backend) and toast in UI. (4) SEND CARD LINK: still returns real Stripe checkout_url (https://checkout.stripe.com/...) AND now persists customer.cardLink.sentAt + lastSessionId (verified via GET /api/customers/R04432057). Backend pytest: 8/8 PASSED. Frontend Playwright full happy-path passed on R04432057.
critical_code_review_comments: monthly_billing_job dedup key is (fiscalId, period, kind='recurring'). Good — but if an admin manually creates an invoice with kind='manual' for the same period, run-monthly will still generate a recurring one on top. Consider adding a UI warning when a manual invoice for the current period already exists.

monthly_billing_job iterates ALL customers (find().to_list(20000)) and awaits Stripe/email sequentially. On growth this will become slow; consider paginating and using asyncio.gather with a semaphore.

In monthly_billing_job, when Stripe off-session charge fails (result.failed++), the invoice is still inserted as 'pending' AND emailed. That is the right behaviour but confusing because the same iteration also counts it in 'failed' — 'failed' really means 'auto-charge failed', not 'invoice failed'. Rename to 'chargeFailed' for clarity.

mark_invoice_paid response uses clean(inv) → good, but the 'alreadyPaid' short-circuit returns only {ok:true, alreadyPaid:true} without the invoice object; UI would need a second GET to refresh. Consider returning the invoice in both branches.

addDiscount in CustomerDetail.js sets amount to the string "-" as placeholder. A <input type=number> will not display "-" (browser normalises it), so the field appears empty and the user must retype. Consider setting amount to '' or a numeric -1 default so users see something.
